_rationale: No taxable account in UserData. ensureReinvestmentAccount adds a $0 'Reinvestment' taxable account before the sim loop. With Traditional $500k and RMD at 73 = 500000/26.5 ≈ 18868, all RMD is excess and deposits into the auto-created account. Results are identical to rmd-excess-to-existing-taxable.

breakdownChecks._note: Most of the RMD is excess; deposited to auto-created taxable

pathValues._note: 0% return + 0 tax (deductions exceed RMD) → Traditional $481,132 + Auto-Taxable $18,868 = $500,000 exactly. Fails at ~$481,132 if deposit is broken.
